label: Phased Plan Drain
description: Prepare a stable phased plan, then drain it with sequential handoff runs that classify progress and reconcile the backlog. Use when the work decomposes cleanly upfront.
best_for: Long sequential plans that agents drain over many runs
A multi-phase plan can be prepared once and stays stable
Continuity across handoffs matters more than parallelism
Explicit progress classification between slices is valuable
not_for: The plan is exploratory or unstable — use holistic-loop
Items are independent and parallel execution wins — use item-level
Work is small enough to fit in a single backlog item
tradeoffs: Continuity over parallelism — one slice at a time
Less planning churn than holistic loop once the plan is stable
Explicit progress classification (continue / replan / complete / blocked) between slices
Heavier upfront plan preparation than holistic loop

prompt.title: Phased Plan Prepare
prompt.purpose: Create or update the stable phased plan used by sequential handoff execution.

prompt.title: Phased Plan Execute Next
prompt.purpose: Execute the earliest contiguous phase block that can be completed professionally and emit a final handoff.

fields.name: handoff
fields.description: The structured handoff the next round consumes — summary, blockers, next step, changed files, tests, and the true frontier the slice advanced to.

prompt.title: Phased Plan Classify Progress
prompt.purpose: Classify phased-plan progress and record backlog reconciliation intent.

fields.name: progress
fields.description: The progress classification state for this slice.

fields.name: progress.decision
fields.description: The classifier's decision: continue draining, blocked (stop), replan, or complete.

prompt.title: Phased Plan Acceptance Review
prompt.purpose: Evaluate phased-plan-drain results, handoffs, and progress against acceptance criteria.

fields.name: verdict
fields.description: Acceptance verdict for the drained initiative against its acceptance criteria. Use accept / accepted when the criteria are met; changes_requested when specific fixable gaps should be re-executed before acceptance (routes back to execute_next); any other non-accepting verdict records the gap and reconciles.

prompt.title: Phased Plan Backlog Reconcile
prompt.trigger: Round refresher auto-starts phased-plan-drain reconcile after review completes
prompt.purpose: Read prior round artifacts and propose backlog mutations that align the initiative with the drained plan.

fields.name: backlog_sync
fields.description: The proposed backlog reconciliation plan aligning the initiative with the drained plan.
